# Paranjape Blue Ridge

> Paranjape Blue Ridge is western Pune's premier 138-acre integrated mega-township located in Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune. Developed by Paranjape Schemes (Construction) Ltd., it offers 2, 3 & 4 BHK luxury residences with a championship 9-hole golf course, private riverfront boat club on Mula river, operational Blue Ridge Public School (ICSE), captive 220/22KVA power substation, and a 3-million sq.ft. walk-to-work IT SEZ campus.

## Flagship Residential Clusters

- [Promenade Residences](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/paranjape-blue-ridge-promenade-hinjewadi-pune): 41-storey river-facing luxury 3 & 4 BHK apartments starting from ₹1.65 Cr. MahaRERA: P52100055581.
- [The Altius](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/paranjape-blue-ridge-the-altius-hinjewadi-pune): Ultra-luxury 3 & 4 BHK golf-view sky residences starting from ₹1.80 Cr. MahaRERA: P52100078116.
- [The Ridges 41](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/paranjape-blue-ridge-41-hinjewadi-pune): 41-storey monolithic MiVAN smart 2 & 3 BHK residences starting from ₹97.60 L. MahaRERA: P52100000054.
- [All Ongoing Clusters](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/blue-ridge/ongoing-projects): Master portfolio of active residential enclaves in Hinjewadi Phase 1.

## Township Infrastructure & Amenities

- [Blue Ridge Public School](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/blue-ridge-public-school): Premier ICSE-affiliated campus inside the township with zero school commute for resident children.
- [9-Hole Golf Course](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/blue-ridge-golf-course): Pune's only integrated township golf course with professional driving range and clubhouse.
- [Blue Ridge Boat Club](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/blue-ridge-boat-club): Private marina and riverfront promenade on the Mula River with kayaking and dining.
- [Blue Ridge IT SEZ Tech Park](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/blue-ridge-sez-tech-park): 3+ Million Sq. Ft. operational Grade-A commercial tech park hosting Cognizant, Accenture, and global MNCs.
- [Hinjewadi Micro-Market Guide](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/hinjewadi-micro-market): Comprehensive real estate and infrastructure analysis of Hinjewadi Phase 1.

## Developer Heritage & Sister Projects

- [Why Paranjape Schemes](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/why-paranjape): 35+ years track record, 50,000+ delivered homes, and 100% MahaRERA compliance.
- [Paranjape Schemes Projects in Pune](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/paranjape-schemes-projects-in-pune): Master developer directory across Pune, Wakad, Baner, and Bhugaon.
- [Paranjape Forest Trails Bhugaon](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/paranjape-forest-trails-bhugaon-pune): 170-acre nature township near Kothrud with equestrian center and luxury villas.
- [Paranjape Athashri Senior Living](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/paranjape-athashri-senior-living-pune): Specialized active senior housing communities in Baner, Bavdhan, and Hinjewadi.
- [Paranjape Trident Towers Wakad](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/paranjape-trident-towers-wakad-pune): High-rise luxury 2 & 3 BHK residences near Hinjewadi flyover.
- [Paranjape Highgardens Hinjewadi](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/paranjape-highgardens-hinjewadi-phase-1): Ergonomic boutique homes designed for modern technology professionals.
- [Paranjape Swaniketan Pune](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/paranjape-swaniketan-inclusive-housing-pune): India's first inclusive residential enclave for adults with special needs.
- [Paranjape Windermere Koregaon Park](https://paranjapeblueridge.com/paranjape-windermere-koregaon-park-pune): Ultra-exclusive private presidential residences in Koregaon Park.
